notes.title: 💋 "Lustful BlackJack: My Succubus Dealer" — A Dangerous Game of Love Begins Soon
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45537850/b5d4b735314be120d17e830c0c206d03062be244.gif[/img]

This title combines classic Blackjack (21) with adult romance interaction. Players must stay calm in the midst of temptation, using both strategy and luck to defeat the alluring succubus dealer.

The game features over 10 high-resolution animated HCGs. Each victory unlocks exclusive interactive events, including intimate conversations, pose variations, and even special voice lines.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45537850/c8784871309176d6eaf7aed589eeee949da5678a.png[/img]

With its dual progression system of “Story × Match”, every win pushes the narrative forward, unlocking more romantic encounters and deepening character relationships.

Players will experience both the thrill of psychological battles and the ultimate tease to the senses.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45537850/6bfaa344436a2165602a6533143003640aecd4e8.png[/img]

In addition to the signature succubus dealer, multiple characters with unique personalities and seductive styles will appear.

As the game progresses, players will uncover their secrets and descend deeper into this labyrinth of desire.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45537850/7196c2442362d9dff5a7834382ce2ac005dd996e.png[/img]

Now—are you ready to take your seat at the table, where the currents of cards and lust collide? ~

notes.notes:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2685500/_/?utm_source=steampost&utm_campaign=en1

Published by Eternal Alice Studio and developed by F Project, the vertical scrolling action game "Falling with Ice Phoenix!" now has a store page on Steam. Scheduled for release in November 2024, interested players can add it to their wishlist to stay updated!

[h2][b]"Retrieve the Lost Orb: A Stairway Adventure for Adults"[/b][/h2]

In a distant, otherworldly land, the protagonist Tavaro, piloting his aircraft, suddenly encounters a storm and crashes. The falling aircraft collides with the Crystal Palace at the top of the Sky Tower.

The Sky Tower, located at the center of the continent, is filled with monsters and traps, and the Crystal Palace is the central hub of the Sky Tower. Flovia, the lord of the Crystal Palace, is playing with the frost orb that controls the entire palace when the crash occurs. Due to the collision caused by Tavaro, Flovia accidentally drops the orb to the bottom of the tower, causing the monsters to lose control and rampage.

To help Flovia retrieve the lost orb, Tavaro uses his expertise to guide her in descending techniques, and the two set off together towards the lower levels. Facing trap-filled floors and malevolent monster lords, an adventure full of unknowns and challenges begins...

[h2][b]"Classic Gameplay with New Twists"[/b][/h2]

Inspired by the famous Japanese mini-game "NS-SHAFT", this vertical scrolling action game incorporates many new elements, including special mechanism floors, hovering techniques, boss attacks, and of course, the "action" elements beloved by old gentlemen!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36388466/2299f4b6b3d4ea5b97999c9422dde29af4a12d45.png[/img]
